channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Denzel Valentine | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Denzel Valentine from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Garrett Temple on Denzel Valentine
item.description:
Temple's approach, and advice to his teammates, is to focus on the granular.

“You can't tell a grown man what to do, obviously. But, for example, getting on the bus, me and Denzel (Valentine) were getting on the bus, and I was like 'Let me get some of this hand sanitizer while I'm walking into the bus.' Denzel was like, 'You right, let me get some too,'”

Garrett Temple on Denzel Valentine, Jan 5, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: John Paxson on Fred Hoiberg, Denzel Valentine
item.description:
Mike McGraw:Paxson:

“We need Cam to play, we need Denzel to play, we need Bobby to play. He (Hoiberg) understands that and he's on board.”

John Paxson on Fred Hoiberg, Denzel Valentine, Feb 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @McGrawDHBulls.

item.title: Gar Forman on Denzel Valentine
item.description:
Mike McGraw:Gar Forman:

“Really, our night went as well as expected. We were optimistic he (Valentine) would be on the board. He was the guy we targeted.”

Gar Forman on Denzel Valentine, Jun 24, 2016. Source: Twitter @McGrawDHBulls.
